module: Editor window "SFX Previewer" (Audio menu) that lists all sound events (FMOD "event:>..." and sound files) of the game and lets you listen to them. The list comes from Sim.getSFXTrackSet(); it is displayed as a folder tree or filtered by a text search. Left click on an event = playback via Engine.Audio.playOnce('AudioGui', name, {position}) at the player vehicle position (or 0,0,0); right click = copy the name to the clipboard. Useful to a modder to find the exact name of an event to put in a jbeam or a scene.
notes: Depends on editor_main; no public function apart from the editor hooks.
Events whose name starts with "event:>" are split on ">"; the others (objects with getSoundFilename) are split on "/" according to the sound file path.
The tree is only rebuilt when the window is shown (onEditorToolWindowShow); the eventsList table is never cleared between two rebuilds (inferred from code: only eventsTree is cleaned).
The sound currently playing is stopped then deleted (stop(-1) then delete) before another is started.

dependencies.desc: Extensions to load before this one: {"editor_main"}.

onUpdate.desc: Draws the SFX Previewer window (search field, folder tree navigation or search results, "Stop Current Sound" button). Does nothing if the editor or the window are not registered.

onEditorToolWindowShow.desc: Hook called when an editor tool window is shown; if it is "sfxPreviewer", rebuilds the sound event list.

onEditorToolWindowHide.desc: Hook called when a tool window is hidden; for "sfxPreviewer", saves the window state (editor.saveWindowsState).

onWindowMenuItem.desc: Called by the Audio > SFX Previewer menu entry; shows the window.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Hook called at editor initialization: registers the window (500x500) and the menu entry in the "Audio" group.
